description: This file defines the AndroidLineMarkerProvider class, which implements the LineMarkerProvider interface to add custom line markers in the IDE for Android-related Java and XML files, enabling navigation to related files.

classes.name: AndroidLineMarkerProvider
classes.description: Provides line markers in the IDE for Android-related Java and XML files, enabling navigation to related files.

classes.name: AndroidLineMarkerProvider.MyMarkerInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a specific line marker, including the element, tooltip, icon, and related items.

classes.name: AndroidLineMarkerProvider.MyNavigationHandler
classes.description: Handles navigation actions when a line marker is clicked, allowing navigation to related files.

methods.name: collectSlowLineMarkers
methods.description: Collects line markers for a list of PSI elements, adding them to the result collection.

methods.name: getLineMarkerInfo
methods.description: Returns null; not used in this implementation.

methods.name: doGetLineMarkerInfo
methods.description: Creates a LineMarkerInfo object for a given PSI element if it is a Java or XML file with related items.

methods.name: getMarkerInfo
methods.description: Determines if a PSI element is a Java or XML file with related items and returns marker info accordingly.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Computes and returns the list of related items for navigation.
